remarks: Welcome to this pristine, beautifully maintained and freshly painted 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse offering 1,725 square feet of beautifully proportioned living space. Hardwood floors flow through the main level, where an open living and dining area is highlighted by a classic fireplace and large glass doors that open to a private deck framed by mature trees and greenery, creating a wonderful extension of the living space for relaxing or entertaining. The bright kitchen features crisp white cabinetry, granite countertops and generous storage, while a powder room adds main-level convenience. Upstairs, two generously sized bedrooms offer hardwood floors and cedar-lined closets, complemented by a full bath on the upper level. An additional cedar-lined coat closet at the entry is a distinctive and practical feature. The finished lower level adds exceptional versatility, with plenty of room for a family room, home office, gym or recreation space, along with a dedicated laundry area and additional storage. Set amid beautifully landscaped grounds with inviting common outdoor space for picnicking, play and enjoying the outdoors, this meticulously cared-for townhouse combines space, character and a peaceful residential setting with the convenience of Stamford living.
